The Petitioner has submitted that it could have declared the COD of said 6 number of links within the SCOD. However, the Petitioner declared the commercial operation of Asset-2 on 3.3.2019 due to clubbing of multiple links in order to reduce the number of assets/petitions as value of individual links was less and it was not justifiable to file separate petitions. We have considered the submissions of the Petitioner and are of the view that the Petitioner had completed 6 number of OPGW links before the SCOD and it also obtained their successful trial on 26.4.2018, 12.5.2018, 20.4.2018, 3.5.2018, 20.6.2018 and 20.5.2018.
